description:
Pre-register for Transformers: Eternal War and get extra rewards: https://www.transformerseternalwar.com/pre-register/?channel=450. Which two Autobots and Decepticons are you most looking forward to seeing fight side by side?

2026's The Mandalorian & Grogu brings the Disney+ Star Wars tv show on the big screen. And it's forgettable at best. Not bad but just vanilla slop you watch and then forget. Less successful than other people's first films like Backrooms and Obsession. And in today's episode of Anatomy of a Failure, let's find how that happened.
